pages.title: Awakening
pages.text: At stage zero, carry the $(item)Ancient Jade$() for one full day or sleep with it nearby to enter stage one. After awakening, use the jade to reopen this book. Ordinary cultivation from stages one through six is never lost on death.

pages.title: If It Is Lost
pages.text: Craft a replacement from a book, emerald, Spirit Crystal and ImmortalPower. The jade is both your manual and the entrance to the cultivation path.

pages.title: The Path at a Glance
pages.text: $(li)Stages 1–4: gather lingqi and advance when the bar fills.$(li)Stage 5: fill the bar, then ascend with an Immortal Pill.$(li)Stage 6: Kongqiao becomes Xianqiao and opens a personal realm.$(li)Stages 6–10: face tribulations only inside your own realm.$(br2)See $(l:immortalstorage:progression/stage_atlas)Stages and Unlocks$(/l) for the full map.

pages.title: Your First Steps
pages.text: Learn $(l:immortalstorage:progression/yuan)TruePower and ImmortalPower$(/l), then brew $(l:immortalstorage:recipes/pills)Spirit-Gathering Pills$(/l). Personal storage expands automatically. The embedded crafting grid opens at stage three, smithing at stage four and the Immortal Furnace at stage five. All keybinds can be changed in Controls.
